decisions.question: What is the maximum allowed Time-To-Live (TTL) numerical duration for an operational T_required override payload in production deployment?
decisions.current_evidence: HD-03 governance model closes operational override precedence, but leaves site-specific numerical TTL to site deployment configuration.

decisions.question: What is the maximum permitted telemetry age (staleness threshold) for StationState telemetry before ECD fails closed to UNKNOWN_INVALID?
decisions.current_evidence: Telemetry freshness requirement established in contract, but exact numerical cutoff depends on SCADA polling frequency.

decisions.question: What cryptographic authentication and authorization mechanism will be deployed at the API ingress layer for operational override payloads?
allowed_options: mTLS Client Certificate Authentication with JWT Role Claims
decisions.current_evidence: Upstream boundary established in BLK-008 resolution audit. ECD module accepts pre-validated AuthorizedHorizon objects.
